infobox.usage: Unlocks a portable guard cabin at the trailer park on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Trailer park portable cabin key (Cabin key) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the portable on-site guard cabins at the trailer park on Customs.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the portable guard cabin at the trailer park on Customs.
